tabs.html:
Lenovo V15 Gen 4 Notebook PC – Intel Core i5-1335U, 8GB RAM, 512GB SSD

Boost your productivity with the Lenovo V15 Gen 4 Notebook, a sleek and reliable laptop designed for professionals and students alike. Powered by the 13th Gen Intel Core i5-1335U processor, it delivers smooth multitasking, fast performance, and efficient energy usage. Its 8GB DDR4 RAM ensures seamless app handling, while the 512GB SSD provides ultra-fast storage for files, software, and media.

The 15.6-inch Full HD display offers crisp visuals, vibrant colors, and wide viewing angles, perfect for work, streaming, and creative tasks. The notebook’s Iron Grey chassis combines elegance with durability, making it ideal for both office and home use.


Key Features & Technical Specifications:

  • Processor: 13th Gen Intel Core i5-1335U (Up to 4.6 GHz, 10 cores)
  • Memory: 8GB DDR4 RAM (Expandable)
  • Storage: 512GB NVMe SSD (Fast boot and load times)
  • Display: 15.6-inch FHD (1920 x 1080), Anti-Glare
  • Graphics: Integrated Intel Iris Xe Graphics
  • Operating System: Windows 11 Home / Pro (depends on region)
  • Connectivity: Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.2, HDMI, USB 3.2, USB-C, RJ-45
  • Battery: Up to 6–8 hours battery life (varies by usage)
  • Weight: Approx. 1.7 kg
  • Color: Iron Grey
  • Security: TPM 2.0, Webcam privacy shutter


Designed for efficiency, the Lenovo V15 Gen 4 Notebook is perfect for office work, online learning, and daily computing tasks. Enjoy a lightweight design, robust performance, and fast storage all in one professional notebook PC.
